name: Full-body Avatar Modeling
definition: A method that anchors 3D Gaussians in a canonical space and deforms them via parametric body models or cage-based rigging to model dynamic motions, using a hybrid deformation strategy.
summary: Full-body Avatar Modeling reconstructs dynamic human avatars by anchoring 3D Gaussians in canonical space and deforming them via parametric body models, distinguishing itself from head-centric approaches by focusing on full-body skeletal rigidity and secondary non-rigid effects.
